samplingAndAuthority.uniqueSampleAuthority: Global integer samples owned once by half-open 16^3 sample bricks; no duplicated physical authority or brick-owned edits.
samplingAndAuthority.meshingSampleWindow: 18^3 values: 17^3 core corners including neighboring +1 planes, plus one-sample negative edge-owner halo for dual-quad ownership.

implementations.surfaceNets: One active-cell vertex at Hermite edge-intersection centroid; dual faces emitted by globally edge-owned sample anchors.
implementations.dualContouring: Separate bounded DC path with Hermite intersections, finite-difference gradients, regularized least-squares QEF, per-cell clamp, and deterministic centroid fallback for numerical/rank failure.
implementations.outputs: Deterministic positions, source/rest positions, normals, rock/dirt weights, indices and mesh hash; no object-per-cell or per-cell managed allocation.
implementations.publication: Writable MeshData, with pure mesher and MeshData fill/apply/upload measured separately.

benchmark.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95; with five runs p95 equals the maximum measured run.
benchmark.allocationBytes: Unavailable. GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread returned no increase for a known 1 KiB probe; reports use -1 sentinel and preserve GC collection counts.

burstReadiness.experiment: Test-only Burst IJobParallelFor sign-classification loop over 314432 active-cell candidates for LayeredRock, seed 20260927, 0.25m spacing, matched 16m domain.
burstReadiness.limitations: Snapshot generation, NativeArray allocation/copy and full mesher work are outside the timed interval. This is not an end-to-end speedup claim or a production runtime-path replacement; runtime core stays engine-light. Burst/Collections references are test-only and manifest dependencies were not changed.

localRefinementExperiment.refinedSample: 0.25m isolated 8m^3 central bounded region, 8 regions, 3092 vertices, 5480 triangles.
localRefinementExperiment.transition: Not stitched or claimed crack-free; the pair shows base and bounded detail sample separately to expose the cost/detail direction.

windowsDevelopmentBuild.playerObservation: player-observation.png and player-observation.json; visible player launch succeeded.

recommendations.status: Selected after independent root inspection of matched captures and implementation.

toolInterventionsAndFailures: No direct Unity MCP tool was exposed; the installed CLI/Pipeline bridge drove the work. No toolchain upgrade or new package install occurred.
An early HDRP/Lit capture was washed out; the final internally authored HDRP-compatible vertex-color shader uses a fixed normal-key/ambient ramp and subtle height/material tint for all matched cases.

The first custom shader revision failed because of an incorrect HDRP include assumption; after correction, vertex-layout ordering initially mapped the wrong channels and produced rainbow colors. Both were repaired before final captures; discarded renders are not presented as evidence.
A hidden Development Player capture attempt failed to produce a screenshot. The same player was rerun visibly and produced the submitted capture and metrics.

Pipeline briefly disconnected during an Editor assembly/domain reload and initially printed 0/0; test_status subsequently returned the actual completed run and current NUnit XML was copied after each final test run.
Build succeeded with two warning categories: Object.FindObjectOfType<T> obsolete warnings and MatterBakeoffPreviewView.DestroyObject hiding a Unity member. No errors.
limitations: Independent root inspection passed the phase and admitted U4.
The local 0.25m region is an isolated sample, not a stitched mixed-resolution mesh; crack-free transitions remain a named risk.
One Windows Development Player observation exists; the benchmark matrix is Editor-only and is not a broad player performance profile.
Managed allocation bytes were unavailable and are reported as such, not zero.
No U4 materials/destruction/support/actors, infinite streaming, production migration or Unreal work was started.
